ValidationRule.description: IM-100: If Budget Categories is None, either Partner or Partner Role must be selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Budget_Validation__c && ( ISBLANK(TEXT(Budget_Categories__c)) || ISNULL(TEXT(Budget_Categories__c)) ) && Partner_Partner_Role__c == FALSE && Type_of_Work__c == FALSE
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Budget Categories "None", either "Partner/Partner Role" or "Type of Work" must be selected.
